metadata.purpose: PK-4 Stage C/D proof (PACK-6/PM3): a multi-hop pack upgrade that SKIPS an intermediate version must still replay that intermediate version's renamedFrom -- the guarantee the whole platform sells. Straight upgrade from renamechain@1.0.0 to @3.0.0, never generating at @2.0.0.
metadata.seedPath: Rows are seeded through the generated app's own CRUD endpoint (see p3-rename's own note for why: inserting over JDBC would prove the row survives, not that the platform wrote it).
